loop.title: Complete Contrapunk's research-backed arrangement preset catalog
loop.checkpoint: The 12-preset performance checkpoint was explicitly cleared on 2026-07-20.

completed_tasks.name: Arrangement V2 foundation, transactional apply, capability gating, and lifecycle safety
Wave 2 research and first 12 operational presets
completed_tasks.evidence: Every preset has three independent cited reports, a parent synthesis, deterministic lifecycle coverage, and honest capability gating.

completed_tasks.name: Wave 3 reusable voicing strategies: Cloister Organum
completed_tasks.evidence: Reusable ExplicitIntervals mode, exact NoteOn/NoteOff ownership, final-pitch routing, Tauri/WASM persistence and controls, and plugin capability gating.

completed_tasks.name: Restore realtime Tauri development guitar analysis
completed_tasks.evidence: The two-second sustain check fell from 6.09s to 0.26s; 226 audio tests passed; hardware sustain was user-confirmed.

completed_tasks.name: Production and v1.3.0 release preparation completed while Phase 10.2 was parked
completed_tasks.evidence: Production UI and universal plug-ins are complete, unfinished built-ins are hidden, Holdsworth HAL versions/codename are set, app and Starlight docs are live, and current product/website CI is green.

remaining_tasks.name: Create three independent Axis Mirror research reports
remaining_tasks.details: Use fresh read-only agents on openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol for history/sources, theory/temporal behavior, and performer/interaction guidance.

remaining_tasks.name: Parent-synthesize Axis Mirror before any implementation
remaining_tasks.details: Write synthesis.md against 10.2-RESEARCH-TEMPLATE.md, then either approve a bounded shared inversion strategy or keep the preset locked.

remaining_tasks.name: Implement and verify Axis Mirror only if research approves it
remaining_tasks.details: Reuse a shared HarmonyEngine strategy, add real controls/capability gates for tunables, and prove exact NoteOn/NoteOff cleanup.

remaining_tasks.name: Continue Waves 3-7
remaining_tasks.details: Complete reusable voicing, phrase/motif, pattern/timing, stable groups/timeline/adaptive scenes, and experimental catalog work.

remaining_tasks.name: Finish the separate v1.3.0 release-candidate gate
remaining_tasks.details: Remove tracked .pi-subagents runtime artifacts, refresh public docs, build and verify six RC assets, complete manual Logic acceptance, and present a go/no-go report. Do not tag without explicit approval.

blockers.description: v1.3.0 tag creation and publication require explicit human approval after the release-candidate report.
blockers.workaround: Complete RC assets and report, then stop for approval.

blockers.description: Final Logic guitar audio-to-MIDI routing acceptance is manual.
blockers.workaround: The user validates Logic; agents must not operate Logic's UI.

human_actions_pending.action: Validate final Logic MIDI FX and Guitar Audio FX routing.
human_actions_pending.context: End-to-end guitar audio -> detection -> virtual CoreMIDI -> instrument acceptance cannot be automated here.

human_actions_pending.action: Approve or reject the v1.3.0 release candidate after the go/no-go report.
human_actions_pending.context: No v1.3.0 tag, GitHub release, or website v1.3.0 download copy may be published before approval.

decisions.decision: Every operational arrangement requires three independent cited reports and a parent synthesis before implementation.
decisions.rationale: Prevents superficial style labels and unsupported artist-imitation claims.

decisions.decision: Use only openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol for all subagent and research work.
Only researchStatus=approved built-ins appear in production arrangement menus; custom presets remain visible.
decisions.rationale: Unfinished presets must not be presented as operational.

decisions.decision: New arrangement behavior must be a shared HarmonyEngine strategy or reusable Companion lane, never a preset-specific algorithm.
decisions.rationale: Keeps all product surfaces consistent and lifecycle ownership testable.

decisions.decision: Arrangement Apply preserves tonic, BPM, transport, devices, routing, sound, master, mute/solo, and plugins.
decisions.rationale: Arrangement presets own musical arrangement state only.

decisions.decision: The v1.3.0 codename is Holdsworth HAL and release website data stays on v1.2.0 until all six v1.3.0 assets exist.

blocking_constraints.name: Research-provider failures
blocking_constraints.evidence: Earlier parallel research launches failed on provider transport or missing Codex credentials.
blocking_constraints.mitigation: Discover agents first, require openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol explicitly, validate written artifacts, and fall back to sequential fresh runs after a failed parallel launch. Stop after three failures.

blocking_constraints.name: Realtime detector throughput
blocking_constraints.evidence: Unoptimized development DSP ran slower than realtime, overflowed the worker queue, and emitted CC123 resets.
blocking_constraints.mitigation: Keep the contrapunk-audio dev optimization; do not compensate by weakening detector thresholds or note ownership.

next_action: Discover executable subagents, then launch three independent fresh-context openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol research reports for preset 13 Axis Mirror; validate all three artifacts before parent synthesis and do not implement inversion behavior first.
context_notes: Thirteen presets are operational: 2, 4, 7, 8, 12, 14, 23, 25, 27, 36, 43, 48, and 1. Phase 10.2 is paused at the start of Axis Mirror research. The product repository is clean at 9a5ace4e. The separate release loop still owes cleanup, public-doc refresh, six RC assets, manual Logic acceptance, and a pre-tag approval gate. Direct VST3 hosting remains parked under Phase 21.C3. Legacy placeholder matches exist in older SUMMARY.md files outside Phase 10.2; none are current Phase 10.2 completion evidence.
